prompts.red:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: transparent production 2D animation sprite atlas, FOUR columns FOUR rows, sixteen whole-body sprites. Image1 is the EDIT TARGET: brown monkey animation sheet. Image2 is a character color/style reference: RED monkey at top middle.
Repaint ONLY the fur of ALL sixteen monkeys in image1 to the SAME rich RED fur as the red monkey in image2. Keep all sixteen exact poses, anatomy, facial expression, foot placements, body scale, camera and sprite layout of image1. Keep the entire atlas, all sixteen sprites, not one enlarged character.
Keep face, inner ears, belly, palms, fingers, toes and soles warm TAN, and keep all armor and wrist cuffs BROWN LEATHER with unchanged coconut badge and trim. No red or blue patches on skin or leather. Match the same soft painterly lighting and brown fine outlines. Hair, cheek ruffs, arms/legs fur, and complete tails become deep red, with natural red highlights and darker red shadows.
Keep the two held coconuts in row3 frames1/2 BROWN; other throw frames have empty hands as in image1. Keep the natural connected thick arms and legs, unchanged proportions.
Absolute invariants: 4x4 arrangement, sixteen distinct action frames, no extra limbs, no lost hands, no cuts, no lettering/grid or shadows, no scenery. True alpha background. Full tails and toes within the sheet. Preserve the exact reference image1 composition and pose sequence, change only fur color, no thin outlines glowing red.
